column1: # How the client's tooltip builder FUN_0149e450 renders each GameAction element (#782).
# 54 of the 260 registered types reach a branch; the other 206 fall to the default and are drawn as nothing.
# 53259 ConeFormula reaches its branch through a plain JZ rather than a table slot, which is why it is last.
# aliasSentence = the TYPE ID whose LDB-170 string this branch fetches with a literal `MOV ECX,<id>` (blank = its own).
# tokens        = the token names it fetches instead/as well, keyed into LDB 170 by elf28(token).
# slotOrder     = the key indices it reads, in the order it reads them (via GetIntStat(GameActionStat_e)).
